findings.evidence: None of these declarations mention `FiniteEtaleScheme`, `toEtale` or `toSheaf`. `Sites/Etale/{ModuleSheaf,Subcanonical,TopologicalInvariance}.lean` already exist as the home for small-étale-site material.
findings.fix: Move these to a new file in the existing `TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Etale/` directory (for example `Sites/Etale/Restrict.lean`) under a `Scheme.Etale` or small-étale namespace. findings.evidence: `isIso_of_forall_isIso_restrictSheaf` is stated for any `φ : G ⟶ F` of `Sheaf (Scheme.smallEtaleTopology S) (Type u)` and any jointly surjective étale family. No finite étale scheme appears in the statement.
findings.fix: Move them to the same `Sites/Etale/` file as the `restrictSheaf` API, outside the `FiniteEtaleScheme` namespace. `Descent.lean` keeps only the representability descent.
findings.issue: Same problem as the previous finding: `isSheafFor_singleton_of_surjective`, `pullback_ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology`, `app_injective_of_forall_isIso_restrictSheaf` and the public `isIso_of_forall_isIso_restrictSheaf` are general facts about étale sheaves of sets with no finite étale content, placed in `FiniteEtale/Descent.lean` under `TauCeti.FiniteEtaleScheme`.

findings.evidence: That module declares only `isIso_of_coversTop` and `isIso_iff_of_coversTop`. Grepping `CoversTop|coversTop` under `TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/FiniteEtale` finds no matches.

summary: `FiniteEtale/RestrictSheaf.lean` and `FiniteEtale/Descent.lean` add a general small-étale-site API (wrappers, over-equivalence, sheaf restriction, étale locality of isomorphisms) under `TauCeti.FiniteEtaleScheme`, although none of it involves finite étale schemes. `RestrictSheaf.lean` also has an unused import.
